*Mayor Tobin pays the town's bounty on the hills: defeat 40 of Kaldemor Hills' monsters. Every round raises Kaldemor's regard for you, and he will pay it again, any time.*

## Objectives

- Defeat 40 Hills monsters ([Pig](../monsters/pig.md), [Orange Mushroom](../monsters/orange_mushroom.md), [Stump](../monsters/stump.md))

## Rewards

- 150 EXP
- 250 mesos
- +20 standing with Kaldemor
